title: Humors shape temperament and age
english: Those who happen to be made of pure blood are always cheerful, playful, and laughing. They look fresh and have a fine complexion. Those who happen to be made of yellow bile are quick and bold, irascible, bitter, and have an unusual coloring. Those who happen to be made of black bile are sluggish and faint-hearted, sickly, hesitant, and timid. Those who happen to be made of phlegm are sorrowful and also cold, forgetful and utterly oblivious, sleeping most of the time, and pale-complexioned.

In childhood, blood increases until the age of fourteen. In youth, yellow bile increases until the age of twenty-eight. In the prime of life, black bile increases until the age of forty-two. In old age, phlegm increases until the age of eighty.

title: Humors, the head's rule, and the brain's parts
english: Children, then, are warm and moist because of blood. Young men are warm and dry because of yellow bile. Those who are full-grown in age are cold and dry because of black bile. Old men are cold and moist because of phlegm. The temple, then, is the ruler of the body. As long as the brain is well settled and healthy, all the limbs of the body are at peace. Power and thought are sent up to the brain from the liver, and the soul itself is there, along with the depth of thoughts. The head has five sutures. There is also a single-sutured head, and it is always healthy. The brain has three membranes: the first is hypozomatias, the second is charakoeides, and the third is ...oeides. The brain has three parts: one is kyreboeides, the second is the thitos, and the third is noeros. It is a warm substance.

title: Brain versus marrow, and the four humors and their seats
english: The brain differs from marrow in being without sorrow and bloodless, while marrow is dirty and full of blood. The human body is composed of four elements, since it contains blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile. Each of these builds its own place: blood on the right side above the liver, yellow bile on the left side above the spleen, black bile in the loins above the kidneys, and phlegm in the chest above the breath. Blood is warm, moist, and sweet; yellow bile is warm...
